posted_snapshot_policy: standards/posted contains the current published revision of every active draft-schrock-* Datatracker record represented in this repository. AE-CHALLENGE-03, Bounded Capability Receipts-03, the four August 6 maintenance revisions, and the earlier publication waves were verified byte-for-byte against the immutable IETF archive before promotion. Exact submitted bytes remain retained in standards/staged as publication provenance, not as upload candidates; the IETF archive remains authoritative for rendered forms and live status.

status_language.active_individual_submission: Published on the IETF Datatracker as an individual Internet-Draft. Not an RFC, not an adopted working-group item, and not IETF endorsement.
status_language.candidate: Repository source under review. Not filed.
status_language.next_wave: Assigned to a dated filing wave but still subject to its explicit technical, related-work, and claim-tracing gates.
status_language.retired_absorbed: Standalone draft is not a filing candidate. Useful substance has an identified canonical owner.
status_language.partner_triggered_profile: Application or commercial profile that returns to the filing lane only with a named external validating party.
status_language.held: Temporary state only. No document may remain held without a dated decision or explicit external trigger.
status_language.canonical_presentation_surface: Reader-facing navigation across current active individual drafts. It creates no consolidation, replacement, update, obsolescence, retirement, or merger relationship.
status_language.publication_provenance_packet: Exact submitted bytes retained for audit after publication. Not an upload candidate or filing queue.
status_language.new_filing_freeze: No new Internet-Draft name or -00 filing may enter the filing lane from 2026-08-04 through 2026-11-01 inclusive. Maintenance revisions under active names remain allowed. The sole exception requires a wire-level gap demonstrated by a named external implementer or named external deployment, recorded evidence, and recorded overlap review.

decision_vocabulary.VERIFIED: One artifact passed its native verifier under relying-party-selected trust inputs.
decision_vocabulary.MATCH: Independently verified artifacts denote the same material action directly or under exact pinned mapping profiles.
decision_vocabulary.SATISFIED: Verified and matched evidence fills every slot in the relying party's evidence requirement.
decision_vocabulary.AUTHORIZED: The relying party's local policy permits execution.
decision_vocabulary.EXECUTED: An executor asserts or attests that an effect occurred.

canonical_four_document_surface.purpose: Canonical reader-facing path from an approval artifact, through host-record binding and scoped authority, to relying-party evidence satisfaction.
canonical_four_document_surface.portfolio_preservation: No active draft is retired, merged, replaced, updated, obsoleted, or subordinated by this surface. Every active_datatracker entry retains its own scope, revision history, and active status; the distinct active profile and lifecycle portfolio remains intact.

documents.label: Authorization Receipts
documents.canonical_question: What action-bound organizational approval evidence was produced under the receipt profile?
documents.boundary: One approval-evidence profile and extension seam; it does not establish scoped authority or evidence satisfaction by itself.

documents.label: Human Authorization Binding
documents.canonical_question: How is named-human authorization evidence bound into an adjacent host record?
documents.boundary: Host-agnostic by-value or by-reference binding; it does not redefine the authorization artifact or host format.

documents.label: Authority Introduction
documents.canonical_question: Under the relying party's trust roots, did the verified key have authority for this scope?
documents.boundary: Trust-root introduction and scoped authority; signature verification alone does not create authority.

documents.label: Authorization Evidence Chain
documents.canonical_question: Does the natively verified, action-matched bundle satisfy the relying party's evidence requirement?
documents.boundary: Returns SATISFIED or UNSATISFIED; it never returns a universal authorization verdict.

active_profile_portfolio.relationship: The canonical PRESENTATION surface and runtime execution spine are navigation views over active work. Neither view retires, merges, replaces, updates, obsoletes, subordinates, or demotes an active profile or lifecycle draft.

runtime_execution_spine.purpose: Runtime path from system boundaries, through exact material-action identity and evidence satisfaction, to executor-side admission and consequence custody.
runtime_execution_spine.relationship_to_presentation_surface: Distinct from the canonical four-document PRESENTATION surface and from the complete active profile portfolio. AEC appears in both views because evidence satisfaction feeds runtime admission, not because the views are equivalent.

documents.label: Architecture
documents.runtime_role: Defines system boundaries and the non-collapsing VERIFIED, MATCH, SATISFIED, AUTHORIZED, and EXECUTED vocabulary.

documents.label: CAID
documents.runtime_role: Identifies and profile-matches the exact material action without authorizing it.

documents.label: AEC
documents.runtime_role: Verifies and composes action-matched evidence into SATISFIED or UNSATISFIED, never AUTHORIZED.

documents.label: AEB
documents.runtime_role: Applies executor-side admission, authority separation, current-status checks, and one-time consequence custody.

new_filing_freeze.scope: No new Internet-Draft name and no -00 filing may enter the filing lane during the freeze.
new_filing_freeze.maintenance_revisions: Allowed under an existing active Datatracker draft name.

only_exception.gap: A wire-level gap that cannot be handled by maintenance of an active draft.
only_exception.demonstration: Demonstrated by a named external implementer or named external deployment.
only_exception.recorded_evidence: Retained evidence identifies the implementer or deployment and demonstrates the wire-level interoperability gap.
only_exception.overlap_review: A retained review records overlap with the active portfolio and adjacent specifications and shows that none already owns the gap.

new_filing_freeze.active_draft_policy: No active draft is retired or merged by this freeze.
new_filing_freeze.profile_policy: The distinct active profile portfolio remains intact.

portfolio_layers.name: architecture
portfolio_layers.question: How do the evidence, authority, decision, and lifecycle layers compose without collapsing their claims?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: Define the separation and binding seams; leave native identity, policy, and transport verification to their owning protocols.

portfolio_layers.name: identity_transport
portfolio_layers.question: Who or what is present in the live channel?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: Consume and bind; do not redefine WIMSE, SPIFFE, or native agent identity.

portfolio_layers.name: delegation_capability_policy
portfolio_layers.question: What authority, capability, or machine policy applies?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: Verify under native rules and treat policy ALLOW as distinct from human approval.

portfolio_layers.name: material_action_identity_mapping
portfolio_layers.question: Do different native artifacts denote the same material action?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: CAID plus relying-party-pinned Action-Mapping Profiles. This is the first post-blackout land claim.

portfolio_layers.name: authorization_evidence
portfolio_layers.question: What approval or authorization event occurred under a named profile?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: Receipts, human-authorization binding, and quorum as non-exclusive evidence profiles.

portfolio_layers.name: evidence_satisfaction
portfolio_layers.question: Does the verified, matched bundle fill the relying party's required evidence slots?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: AEC returns SATISFIED or UNSATISFIED, never a universal authorization verdict.

portfolio_layers.name: execution_lifecycle
portfolio_layers.question: Was evidence demanded, consumed, executed, observed, revoked, and preserved correctly?
portfolio_layers.emilia_position: Challenge, enforcement, outcome, revocation, evidence record, and application profiles remain separate transitions.

retired_absorbed.canonical_owner: Proof predicates in relying-party profiles and native receipt verifier outputs
retired_absorbed.reason: S/H/V/Q created a second assurance language beside the existing receipt and scoped-authority vocabularies. The standalone taxonomy is retired before filing.
The active Authority Introduction draft owns trust-root introduction and scoped authority.
Its composition map is fully absorbed by Architecture-02.
Crypto agility, re-anchoring, and hybrid anti-stripping belong with long-term evidence preservation rather than a standalone algorithm catalog.

partner_triggered_profiles.trigger: A regulator, government program, or management-system standards partner validates the control-to-evidence mapping.

consolidation_rules: The canonical four-document surface is presentation-only; it does not retire, merge, replace, update, obsolete, or subordinate any active draft.
The Architecture-02, CAID-01, AEC-05, and AEB-03 runtime execution spine is a separate navigation view; it does not replace the canonical PRESENTATION surface or the active profile portfolio.
Architecture-02 absorbs the retired Agent Trust Stack map.
AEC owns component verification, action binding, and evidence satisfaction; it does not define effect or ceremony records.
Quorum owns ordered multi-handshake and distinct-human policy semantics.
Receipts owns the base receipt and explicit approval profile, not every approval mechanism.
Challenge will profile AuthZEN AARP's requestable denial and PDP-verifiable approval state instead of redefining its workflow.
Revocation Statement-01 owns terminal negative evidence; current non-revocation remains a separately authenticated, policy-fresh status input.
Assurance requirements are verifier-visible proof predicates; no standalone universal S/H/V/Q taxonomy is being filed.
Authority Introduction owns trust-root introduction and scoped authority; no separate Authority Registry draft is filed.
Evidence Record owns crypto agility and hybrid anti-stripping; no standalone PQC algorithm catalog is filed.
